_about: Hand-written rules that turn recognized signs into English. Not AI: each rule is a fixed pattern. In a pattern, {X} stands for any one sign or fingerspelled word and {W} for a fingerspelled word only. A pattern must match the whole line (unknown '?' segments are ignored). When no rule matches, the signs are shown as plain words, and a fingerspelled word on its own is shown capitalized. The raw signs and letters are always shown underneath. Two general joining rules live in index.html (addLine): a fingerspelling-only line within joinMs of an unfinished line (no closing . ? !) that ended in a fingerspelled word continues that line, and a line can complete a rule together with the line just before it.

rules.note: A line that is only UNDERSTAND is shown as a question. In ASL raised eyebrows make it a question; STAT does not read faces, so this is a fixed rule about the sign standing alone.
